title: 💡 If you’re the smartest person in the room… you’re in the wrong room.
description:
💡 If you’re the smartest person in the room… you’re in the wrong room.

Had the chance to be in a room with Matt Ishbia, CEO of United Wholesale Mortgage and owner of the Phoenix Suns.

Hearing how he thinks and operates at that level… that kind of energy carries.

Surround yourself with people who challenge you
That’s where growth happens

If you’re military, a veteran, or planning to buy or sell in Central Texas, we’re here to help.
